How Manara works

Manara manages your child's Android phone openly. The phone always shows a notice saying it is managed, and opening Manara on it shows exactly which rules are on and what you can see. There is no hidden mode. Manara never keeps or passes on messages, never sees photos and never listens to calls.

You set the rules in the console, a web page you open on your own phone or computer. Manara on the child's phone applies them, and keeps applying them without a connection. To see what it does first, watch the short videos.

Before you start

Setup takes about 20 to 30 minutes, longer on a Samsung. No app is uninstalled and no app data is lost. Prepare:

  • The phone runs Android 11 or newer, is on Wi-Fi, and is charged above 50%, or on its charger. No computer or cable is needed.
  • On a Samsung every account is removed for a moment, and on a Xiaomi the Google (and Google Meet) account; other brands are not tested yet. They are signed back in at the end. Check now that you can get back in to the phone's Google account without remembering its password: a passkey on your own phone, a code by SMS to its recovery phone, or a Family Link password reset if you created the account. Manara never sees or stores passwords.
  • A new phone, with nothing on it? The console's other way scans one QR code instead, but it erases the phone: never use it on a phone your child already uses.
  • As a precaution, back up chats (for WhatsApp: Settings, Chats, Chat backup).
  • On a Samsung, a Secure Folder must be removed first: move anything you need out of it. On a Xiaomi, turn off cloned apps first (Settings, Apps, Cloned apps): the clone and its data are deleted, the main app stays.
  • On a Xiaomi, once Manara is installed, turn on Autostart for it and set its battery saver to No restrictions (Settings, Apps, Manage apps, Manara), or it stops after every restart.
  • Tell your child the phone will be managed, and why.

Rather not do it alone? Join the founding families: we set it up with you on a call.

1. Create your account

Open the console, choose New here? Create an account, and enter your email address and a password of at least 8 characters. Use an address you check: password-reset links and alerts go there.

2. Connect the phone

  1. Install Manara on your child's phone: open the download page on that phone. The console's + Add a phone also shows a QR code that opens it.
  2. In the console, choose + Add a phone. Confirm the three statements (you are the parent or guardian, the child is a minor, the child will be told), then choose The phone your child already uses.
  3. Follow the console's steps for the phone's brand to turn on Wireless debugging: usually Settings, About phone, tap Build number seven times (on a Xiaomi: OS version), then Developer options, Wireless debugging. If a menu name differs, search for it in Settings.
  4. The console shows a connection code, as a QR code and as text. On the phone, open Manara and tap Scan the code, or type it.

3. Guided setup

  1. On the phone, tap Start guided setup in Manara, then open Wireless debugging. Leave the phone on that screen, unlocked and charging: Android stops pairing the moment you leave it, and a phone left to sleep loses the connection.
  2. In the console, open the phone's page and pair it: with Pair device with QR code on the phone, or Pair device with pairing code and the 6 digits typed into the console.
  3. Setup then runs by itself, and the console shows each step. Manara pauses the apps that hold an account for a few seconds, becomes the phone's manager, and turns them back on.
  4. If Android also needs accounts removed (Samsung, Xiaomi), the console lists them, shows how you'll get back in to each one, and asks you to confirm first. Then tap Open accounts in Manara's notice on the phone and remove them. Don't uninstall any app.
  5. At the end, sign back in, Google first, from Manara's notice. Apps like Facebook usually come back by themselves. Then choose Finish setup in the console.

If the phone restarts during setup, before Manara manages it, setup stops: the console says so. Open Manara and start guided setup again; accounts already removed stay removed.

4. Choose the rules

Open the phone in the console. Every rule is off until you turn it on, and the child sees each one on the phone. To start quickly, choose your child's age at the top of the Rules tab.

Rules tab

  • Adult sites: blocked in Chrome and in apps; other browsers are closed, and Google stays on SafeSearch.
  • Ads in games and apps: stops most ad networks.
  • Family values: well-known gambling, dating and alcohol websites, in Chrome.
  • Social media and Games: one daily budget each.
  • Bedtime: at night apps pause; calls, texts, WhatsApp, Quran apps, the clock and Settings still work.
  • Keep the rules on: no factory reset from Settings, safe mode, new users or clock changes. On by default.
  • Under More options: limits app by app, other pause times (school, prayer), Chrome settings, each setting to lock (VPN, Private DNS, developer options), and Wait before loosening: a loosened rule waits before it reaches the phone, and you can cancel it meanwhile.

What you see tab

What the phone sends you, each one only while you turn it on, and listed on the child's phone while it is:

  • Location, at the interval you choose.
  • Daily app usage: minutes per app.
  • Call history and Calls from numbers you don't know (you list the numbers you know): Android, with the version downloaded from the website.
  • Apps installed or removed: their name and the time.

This phone tab

  • Your child's name and a color, and removing Manara (see 7).

A saved rule reaches the phone within seconds. The console says when it can't, and when the phone will get it instead.

5. Every day

  • Lock now, at the top of the phone's page, locks the phone in a few seconds.
  • The Activity tab shows whether every protection is working, screen time, time by app, calls and apps installed or removed (for what you turned on).
  • The list of phones shows when each phone last checked in.

6. Alerts

Manara emails you when:

  • a phone hasn't checked in for 12 hours: it may be off, out of battery or offline, or Manara may have been stopped;
  • a protection stops working, for example Usage access turned off;
  • a number you don't know calls your child, if you turned that on.

And every Monday morning, an email says last week's report is ready (you can turn it off under Account).

You get one email per problem, not one at every check-in. Check your spam folder the first time.

7. Move or remove Manara

Only you can do this. Manara on the phone has no button for it, so your child can't remove it.

  • Remove Manara from this phone (This phone tab): within seconds, or at the phone's next check-in if it is offline, every rule is lifted and the phone becomes an ordinary phone again.
  • Move to another account: for example, to the other parent's account. The phone keeps its setup.
  • Phone can't be reached? Choose Show release code and type the code on the phone, in Manara, under Release this phone. Then choose Remove from my list.
  • A lost or reset phone: Remove from my list.

To delete your account and all its data, see Delete your account.

If something goes wrong

Play Protect blocks the installation

On some phones Google Play Protect blocks Manara outright. Don't change a security setting on your own: write to us, or join the founding families, and we install it with you.

Setup stays on "pairing"

The phone must stay on the Wireless debugging screen until pairing is done. Open it again, choose the QR code or the pairing code again, and try once more. The phone and the console must both be online.

The phone shows "Not reporting"

The phone hasn't checked in for 2 hours. Check that it is on and online. Opening Manara on it and tapping Check now makes it check in at once. On some phones, battery saving stops apps in the background: allow Manara to run without restrictions in the phone's battery settings (on a Xiaomi, also turn on Autostart).

Forgot your password

On the sign-in page, choose Forgot your password?. The emailed link works for one hour.
